evidence.label: mcp-js-prototype-pollution-merge-loop (medium/medium)
evidence.detail: Keys from a caller-supplied object are copied onto a target without excluding __proto__ / constructor / prototype. A tool argument carrying __proto__ then mutates Object.prototype for the whole process, which can turn an unrelated later property read into attacker-controlled data.

const bootQ=()=>PROJECT?'?'+pq():''; // project 0 is asked for without the parameter: with nothing served the server answers the no-project state (BL-080)
fetch('/api/specs'+bootQ(),{cache:'no-store'})
  .then(r=>{if(!r.ok&&PROJECT){PROJECT=0;return fetch('/api/specs'+bootQ(),{cache:'no-store'});}return r;})
  .then(r=>{if(!r.ok)throw new Error('/api/specs: HTTP '+r.status);return r.json();})
  .then(d=>{DATA=d;renderAll();route();listen();})

evidence.label: transport_security
evidence.detail: declared endpoint(s) are HTTPS: https://init.specpilot.dev/mcp; scored 80, not 100: `03` §4 reserves 100 for HTTPS *with HSTS*, and an HSTS header can only be seen by connecting, which `04` §9 does not do. This is an unverifiable band, not an observed absence.

evidence.label: secret_handling
evidence.detail: detect-secrets matched 205 credential-shaped string(s), every one from a keyword or entropy heuristic (Basic Auth Credentials, Hex High Entropy String, Secret Keyword). Those flag placeholders, variable names and content hashes as readily as credentials, so they do not establish the committed credential `03` §4's 0 asserts, and this sub-check is not scored; Secret Keyword at .specs/development/context.md:204; Basic Auth Credentials at .specs/quality/tests.md:123; Basic Auth Credentials at .specs/quality/tests.md:174; Hex High Entropy String at src/__tests__/__snapshots__/specCore.test.ts.snap:5; Hex High Entropy String at src/__tests__/__snapshots__/specCore.test.ts.snap:6; Hex High Entropy String at src/__tests__/__snapshots__/specCore.test.ts.snap:7; Hex High Entropy String at src/__tests__/__snapshots__/specCore.test.ts.snap:8; Hex High Entropy String at src/__tests__/__snapshots__/specCore.test.ts.snap:9; Hex High Entropy String at src/__tests__/__snapshots__/specCore.test.ts.snap:10; Hex High Entropy String at src/__tests__/__snapshots__/specCore.test.ts.snap:11; …and 195 more matches
